Notes: [2] Cleaysh-hramman] [lit; ‘elder ear’] this entry is added as a note after [Tramman]. [Note by RT: This refers to the type of fungi that grows on elder trees, called ‘jelly ear’ in English. In Manx folklore these are said to be ears left on the tree by the mooinjer-veggey as bugging devices when they themselves are out-of-sight in order to listen on humans. Left soaking in water overnight they swell and take on the appearance of ears.]
